title: Zesty French Chicken Quiche
description: A crispy one-pot French quiche with caramelized sugar sauce, poached chicken, and a zesty garlic‑lemon twist.
instructions: In a bowl mix flour, salt, and cold butter cubes; rub until mixture resembles coarse crumbs.
Add ice water gradually, stirring until dough comes together; press into a disc, wrap plastic, chill 15 min.
While dough rests, melt 2 tbsp butter in a skillet over medium heat; add brown sugar and stir until caramelized.
Add minced garlic (if using) to the caramel, cook 30 sec, then stir in diced chicken and thyme; season with salt and pepper.
In a bowl whisk eggs, milk, half-and-half, lemon zest, and grated parmesan until smooth.
Roll chilled dough onto floured surface to 12-inch circle; transfer to a 9-inch tart pan, pressing into bottom and sides; trim.
Spoon the chicken mixture evenly over crust; pour the egg mixture over, filling about 3/4 cup.
Bake for 30 minutes until crust is golden and custard set; let rest 5 min before slicing.
Serve warm with a side of mixed greens.
